ei.title: Weak AI vs. Strong AI: Exploring Key Differences
ei.subject: 영어2

fullPassage: Strong AI and Weak AI are two fascinating branches of artificial intelligence that capture our imagination. Strong AI, like something from a sci-fi movie, can think, learn, and perform various tasks and cope with various situations just like humans. The current level of AI systems cannot do such things yet. Weak AI, on the other hand, the kind we now encounter daily, focuses on conducting one job well. It can do things such as recommending movies, giving us directions, or even helping us pick the perfect songs. However, it outperforms humans only in the specific tasks it is designed for, and it operates under far more constraints than even the most basic human intelligence. There are several differences between Weak AI and Strong AI. Did you know that the computer playing chess and the helpful voice assistant on your phone are both examples of Weak AI? They may be impressive, but they're designed for specific tasks and can't handle anything outside their programming. Weak AI is a category of artificial intelligence confined to a finite domain. By performing operations that require considerable time and utilizing methods that are not always accessible to people, this technology can be advantageous to society. It concentrates on tasks such as responding to user input searches or playing games. While it is only as good as its programming and training, Weak AI still helps convert enormous amounts of data into useful information by identifying patterns and generating predictions. Strong AI is designed to mimic the cognitive abilities of a human being. It is called "strong" because it has the potential to perform a wide range of tasks, rather than being limited to a specific set of tasks. The more an AI system approaches the abilities of a human being, with all our intelligence, emotion, and broad knowledge, the "stronger" the AI system is considered. One of the key characteristics of Strong AI is that it is designed to learn and adapt to new situations. It can generalize from its training data and apply its knowledge to new situations. For example, a Strong AI system designed to recognize objects in images can learn to recognize objects it hasn't seen before based on its previous training. Another key attribute of Strong AI is that it is designed to be self-aware and conscious. This means that it can think, reason, and make decisions like a human being. While current AI systems are far from achieving this level of intelligence, some researchers believe that it is possible to create Strong AI in the future.

questions.passage: Strong AI and Weak AI are two (A)[fascinating / dull] branches of artificial intelligence that capture our imagination. Strong AI, like something from a sci-fi movie, can think, learn, and perform various tasks and cope with various situations just like humans. The current level of AI systems cannot do such things yet. Weak AI, on the other hand, the kind we now encounter daily, (B)[focuses / hesitates] on conducting one job well. It can do things such as recommending movies, giving us directions, or even helping us pick the perfect songs. However, it (C)[underperforms / outperforms] humans only in the specific tasks it is designed for, and it operates under far more constraints than even the most basic human intelligence.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① fascinating(매력적인)+focuses(집중하다)+outperforms(능가하다) ← 정답
❌ ② dull(지루한)은 '상상력을 사로잡는' 두 인공지능을 소개하는 문맥과 반대
❌ ③ hesitates(주저하다)는 약한 인공지능이 한 가지 일에 '집중한다'는 문맥과 어긋남
❌ ④ underperforms(기대에 못 미치다)는 특정 과업에서 인간을 '능가한다'는 문맥과 반대
det.tip: fascinating=매력적인, focus on=~에 집중하다, outperform=~을 능가하다

questions.passage: Did you know that the computer playing chess and the helpful voice assistant on your phone are both examples of Weak AI? They may be (A)[impressive / disappointing], but they're designed for specific tasks and can't handle anything outside their programming. Weak AI is a category of artificial intelligence (B)[confined / expanded] to a finite domain. By performing operations that require considerable time and utilizing methods that are not always accessible to people, this technology can be (C)[harmful / advantageous] to society. It concentrates on tasks such as responding to user input searches or playing games. While it is only as good as its programming and training, Weak AI still helps convert enormous amounts of data into useful information by identifying patterns and generating predictions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① disappointing(실망스러운)은 뒤의 but과 어울리지 않고, 체스·음성 비서 예시는 '인상적'이어야 함
✅ ② impressive(인상적인)+confined(한정된)+advantageous(이로운) ← 정답
❌ ③ expanded(확장된)는 '유한한 영역(finite domain)'에 한정된다는 문맥과 반대
❌ ④ harmful(해로운)은 사회에 '이로울' 수 있다는 문맥과 반대
det.tip: impressive=인상적인, be confined to=~에 한정되다, advantageous=이로운

questions.passage: Strong AI is designed to (A)[mimic / ignore] the cognitive abilities of a human being. It is called "strong" because it has the potential to perform a wide range of tasks, rather than being limited to a specific set of tasks. The more an AI system approaches the abilities of a human being, with all our intelligence, emotion, and broad knowledge, the "stronger" the AI system is considered. One of the key characteristics of Strong AI is that it is designed to learn and (B)[adapt / resist] to new situations. It can (C)[memorize / generalize] from its training data and apply its knowledge to new situations. For example, a Strong AI system designed to recognize objects in images can learn to recognize objects it hasn't seen before based on its previous training.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① ignore(무시하다)는 인간의 인지 능력을 '모방하도록' 설계된다는 문맥과 반대
❌ ② resist(저항하다)는 새로운 상황에 '적응하도록' 설계된다는 문맥과 반대
✅ ③ mimic(모방하다)+adapt(적응하다)+generalize(일반화하다) ← 정답
❌ ④ memorize(암기하다)는 훈련 데이터로부터 '일반화한다'는 문맥과 반대
det.tip: mimic=모방하다, adapt to=~에 적응하다, generalize=일반화하다

questions.passage: Strong AI and Weak AI are two fascinating branches of artificial intelligence that ①<u>capture</u> our imagination.  Strong AI, like something from a sci-fi movie, can think, learn, and ②<u>perform</u> various tasks and cope with various situations just like humans. It can do things such as recommending movies, giving us directions, or even helping us pick the perfect songs.  However, it outperforms humans only in the ④<u>random</u> tasks it is designed for, and it operates under far more constraints than even the most basic human intelligence.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ random → specific: 설계된 '특정' 과업에서만 인간을 능가한다
det.analysis:
✅ ① capture: 우리의 상상력을 '사로잡는다' 적절
✅ ② perform: 다양한 과업을 '수행한다' 적절
✅ ③ encounter: 우리가 매일 '접하는' 종류의 인공지능 적절
❌ ④ random(무작위의) → specific(특정한): 약한 인공지능은 '설계된 특정 과업에서만' 인간을 능가하므로 random은 문맥에 맞지 않음 ← 정답
det.tip: the specific tasks it is designed for(설계된 특정 과업) → specific(특정한) ↔ random(무작위의)

det.analysis:
❌ ① disappointing(실망스러운) → impressive(인상적인): 뒤에 '하지만(but) 특정 과업용으로 설계되었다'가 이어지므로 앞에는 '인상적이다'가 와야 자연스러움 ← 정답
✅ ② confined: 유한한 영역에 '한정된' 범주 적절
✅ ③ considerable: '상당한' 시간이 필요한 작업 적절
✅ ④ concentrates: 과업에 '집중한다' 적절
det.tip: 뒤의 but(하지만)과 호응 → 앞은 impressive(인상적인), disappointing(실망스러운)은 반대

It is called "strong" because it has the potential to perform a wide range of tasks, rather than being limited to a specific set of tasks. det.analysis:
✅ ① cognitive: 인간의 '인지' 능력을 모방 적절
❌ ② narrow(좁은) → broad(광범위한): 인간의 지능·감정과 함께 언급되는 지식은 '광범위한' 지식이어야 하며, AI가 인간 능력에 가까울수록 더 '강하다'는 흐름과 어울림 ← 정답
✅ ③ generalize: 훈련 데이터로부터 '일반화한다' 적절

questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B) 두 문장에서 밑줄 친 branches의 의미로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) two fascinating branches of artificial intelligence = 인공지능의 두 가지 매력적인 '분야(부문)', (B) the tree lost its thick branches = 나무가 두꺼운 '나뭇가지'를 잃었다 ← 정답
❌ ② (A)는 '나뭇가지'가 아니라 '분야'
❌ ③ (B)의 branches는 '강둑'이 아니라 '나뭇가지'
❌ ④ (A)의 branches는 '지점(은행 지점)'이 아니라 학문·기술의 '분야'
det.tip: branch = ① (학문·기술의) 분야, 부문 ② 나뭇가지 ③ (은행·회사의) 지점

det.tip: 모습·행동·소리를 똑같이 따라 하다 = mimic(모방하다) ≒ imitate, copy

questions.passage: By performing operations that require considerable time and utilizing methods that are not always accessible to people, this technology can be advantageous to society. It __________ (concentrate) on tasks such as responding to user input searches or playing games.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.analysis: It ___ on tasks는 '그것(약한 인공지능)은 ~한 과업에 집중한다'라는 뜻이에요. 주어 It은 3인칭 단수이고 현재 시제이므로 동사원형 concentrate에 -s를 붙여 concentrates가 돼요. 'concentrate on(~에 집중하다)'. 주어가 단수(It)이면 현재형 동사에 -s를 붙입니다.
det.tip: 3인칭 단수 주어(It) + 현재형 동사 → 동사원형 + s: concentrate → concentrates

questions.passage: It can generalize from its training data and apply its knowledge to new situations. For example, a Strong AI system designed to recognize objects in images can learn to recognize objects it hasn't __________ (see) before based on its previous training.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.analysis: objects it hasn't ___ before는 '전에 본 적 없는 대상들'이라는 뜻이에요. 조동사 has/hasn't 뒤에는 과거분사(p.p.)가 와서 현재완료(경험)를 만드므로 see의 과거분사 seen을 써서 hasn't seen(본 적 없다)이 돼요. see-saw-seen의 3단 변화 중 과거분사형이에요.
det.tip: has/hasn't + 과거분사(p.p.) = 현재완료 → see의 과거분사는 seen

questions.passage: Strong AI and Weak AI are two fascinating branches of artificial intelligence that capture our imagination.  Strong AI, like something from a sci-fi movie, can think, learn, and perform various tasks and cope with various situations __________.  The current level of AI systems cannot do such things yet.  Weak AI, on the other hand, the kind we now encounter daily, focuses on conducting one job well.  It can do things such as recommending movies, giving us directions, or even helping us pick the perfect songs.  However, it outperforms humans only in the specific tasks it is designed for, and it operates under far more constraints than even the most basic human intelligence.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① without any training: '아무 훈련 없이'는 사고·학습·대처 능력을 설명하는 문맥과 어울리지 않음
✅ ② just like humans: 강한 인공지능이 생각하고 학습하며 다양한 상황에 대처할 수 있다는 것은 '꼭 인간처럼' 할 수 있다는 의미 ← 정답
❌ ③ only in laboratories: '실험실에서만'은 본문에 없는 내용
❌ ④ after a long time: '오랜 시간 후에'는 문맥과 무관
det.tip: think, learn, perform, cope ~ (인간이 하는 일들) → just like humans(꼭 인간처럼)

questions.passage: Strong AI is designed to mimic the cognitive abilities of a human being.  It is called "strong" because it has the potential to perform a wide range of tasks, rather than being limited to a specific set of tasks.  The more an AI system approaches the abilities of a human being, with all our intelligence, emotion, and broad knowledge, the "stronger" the AI system is considered.  One of the key characteristics of Strong AI is that it is designed to learn and adapt to new situations.  It can generalize from its training data and apply its knowledge to new situations.  For example, a Strong AI system designed to recognize objects in images can learn to recognize objects it hasn't seen before based on its previous training.  Another key attribute of Strong AI is that it is designed to be __________.  This means that it can think, reason, and make decisions like a human being.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸에 self-aware and conscious(자기 인식과 의식이 있는)가 적절
det.analysis:
❌ ① limited to one task: '한 가지 과업에 한정된'은 약한 인공지능의 특징이라 강한 인공지능 문맥과 반대
❌ ② afraid of humans: '인간을 두려워하는'은 본문에 없는 내용
❌ ③ unable to learn: '학습할 수 없는'은 학습·적응하도록 설계된다는 문맥과 반대
✅ ④ self-aware and conscious: 뒤 문장에서 '인간처럼 생각하고 추론하며 결정을 내릴 수 있다'고 하므로 강한 인공지능은 '자기 인식과 의식이 있도록' 설계된다가 적절 ← 정답
det.tip: 뒤 문장 can think, reason, and make decisions like a human being → self-aware and conscious(자기 인식·의식이 있는)
